•     Monitor and control feed rate and speed.
•     Ensure workpiece is properly lubricated and/or cooled.
•     Regulate temperature of workpiece.
•     Detect problems by listening for specific sounds.

•     Monitor the accuracy of cuts.
•     Replace dull cutting tools.

•     Record the testing
•     ID cylinder with job number
•     Completed cylinder for spraying
•     Torque nuts and bolts to right specifications
•     Press the bushes

Qualifications/Knowledge/Skills/Experience

•     Good mechanical aptitude.
•     Excellent reading comprehension

Kogan People Solutions are working with an ISO 9001:2015 Certified trailer manufacturer based in Tottenham, Victoria. They specialize heavily in custom-built top tier single axle, tandem and custom built trailers tailored to specific trade, commercial, or landscaping needs. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for completing high quality metal fabrication work utilised in the production of these trailers. You will attend to all tasks safely and effectively, applying knowledge of materials, fabrication techniques and relevant industry standards. 

•	Location – Tottenham, VIC

•	Tenure – Full time and ongoing

•	Salary – negotiable in the range $78k to $85k plus superannuation per annum

Responsibilities Include:

•	Interpret technical engineering plans, blueprints and other fabrication drawings

•	Select, prepare, assemble and finish high quality metal components 

•	Set up and skilfully use MIG, TIG and Stick welding techniques according to project requirements 

•	Operate heat and thermal cutting equipment safely and effectively 

•	Operate workshop machinery and fabrication tools relevant to trailer manufacturing 

•	Assemble, tack and fit components to form trailer structures and frames

About you:

You have a passion for the metalworking industry and are up to date on the latest industrial and safety techniques. Your work history shows you demonstrate an unwavering commitment to welding of the highest quality, whilst working within a cohesive and hardworking team environment.

To succeed in this role, you:
•	Possess a relevant Certificate IV in a highly relevant field of study or an agreed equivalent 

•	Have 3 or more years of trade / professional experience working in similar roles

•	Have great attention to detail, high quality of work and proven experience in the welding field.

•	Are able to skilfully read and interpret blueprints and fabrication drawings

•	Work with a high level of safety awareness at all times

•	Are capable of undertaking physical labour, including safe use of workshop equipment (such as overhead cranes)

•	Are experienced in MIG, TIG and Stick welding techniques.

•	Offer proven ability to prioritise, set goals and have the determination to achieve them.

•	Enjoy working in and around cohesive teams and follow instructions.

•	Be very safety conscious, comfortable always using PPE.

You must have unrestricted full time Australian working rights to be considered.

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence

Seeking Expressions of Interest - Experienced Area Manager in Sydney - Commercial Cleaning Industry
Consider a change in industry, increased stability and longevity, multiple Roles Available

$100,000 - $120,000 per year (includes vehicle allowance)

About the business
Operating for over 35 years Dimeo Cleaning Services has been providing Australian business, industry and institutions with a more thorough clean. Privately owned, Dimeo sets out to deliver clients in every capital city maximum value for money and ROI. That's why not only major corporations and blue chip property fund managers, but also private companies and many smaller clients are amongst our satisfied clients. 

The average length of contract for the properties we currently service exceeds 10 years. 
Given the quality of our clients and the quality of our service, Dimeo is seeking to fill the position of Area Manager to service some of our most prominent clients.

About the role
In the role of Area Manager, you will have autonomy to deliver known business outcomes within a transparent operational framework.

The role mainly consists of:
•	Completing contract reviews and negotiating variations with each of the clients
•	Preparing, reviewing and submitting monthly and quarterly reports concerning the contracts to clients and senior management
•	Develop, review and negotiate variations to the contract, programs, projects and services
•	Maintaining budgets, preparing and submitting annual contract cost increases 
•	Advising Executive Managers on matters requiring attention to ensure their decisions are implemented
•	Tracking and achieving contractual and business KPI’s including general strategy, contract retention and site/portfolio profitability 
•	Responding to inquiries, resolving problems concerning contracted services and implementing required changes
•	Recruiting, training and developing the management team to ensure contract compliance and succession 
•	Oversee work by contractors and report on variations to work orders. 
•	Managing & owning customer relationships
•	Business development and profit optimisation across the contract portfolio
•	Managing paperwork related with contracts and variations

Skills and experience
The skills and qualifications that this position requires include:
•	Management and operations experience this is a necessity 
•	Minimum 2 years' experience in the titled role or a highly relevant field such as Construction, Engineering, IT, Maintenance, etc.
•	Strong connection to our corporate culture and understanding of our values and ideals.
•	Accountability, autonomy, responsibility and adaptability are sought after qualities in the right candidate 

Remuneration/Salary
•	Market leading based on commensurate experience
•	Package to include vehicle allowance

result.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Plasterer — Wall & Ceiling Linings to join our team on a full-time basis in Townsville, Queensland.
The successful applicant will work on a range of commercial construction projects, including fit-outs, refurbishments and new building works. This role requires a skilled tradesperson with strong experience in wall and ceiling linings, plasterboard installation, suspended ceiling systems and commercial construction site requirements.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

The successful applicant will be responsible for:
•	Reading and interpreting construction drawings, plans and specifications
•	Measuring, marking and cutting plasterboard, fibre cement sheeting, ceiling tiles and lining materials
•	Installing plasterboard wall linings, partitions, bulkheads and ceiling systems
•	Installing suspended ceilings, grid systems, acoustic ceiling tiles and associated framing
•	Fixing plasterboard, fibre cement, acoustic and composite wall linings to walls, ceilings and battens
•	Setting joints, internal and external angles, corner beads and trims
•	Applying compounds, tapes and finishing materials to achieve smooth, level surfaces
•	Installing fire-rated and acoustic wall and ceiling systems in accordance with project specifications
•	Carrying out patching, repairs and finishing works as required
•	Ensuring work is completed to a high standard and in accordance with workplace health and safety requirements
•	Working collaboratively with site supervisors, builders, subcontractors and other trades
•	Maintaining tools, equipment and a clean, safe work area

Skills and Experience Required

Applicants must have:
•	Trade qualification in plastering, wall and ceiling lining, or a closely related field; or at least 3 years of relevant trade experience
•	Demonstrated experience as a plasterer or wall and ceiling liner, preferably in commercial construction
•	Experience installing plasterboard walls, ceilings, suspended ceiling systems and associated framing
•	Ability to read and interpret plans, drawings and specifications
•	Strong understanding of commercial construction site procedures and workplace health and safety requirements
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team
•	Good attention to detail and ability to deliver high-quality finishes
•	Current construction White Card
•	Own basic trade tools
•	Driver licence & reliable transport required

What We Offer
•	Full-time employment. 
•	Annual salary of $80,000 plus superannuation. 
•	Ongoing work on commercial construction projects in Townsville and surrounding areas. 
•	Supportive team environment. 
•	Opportunity to work on varied and high-quality commercial projects. 

How to Apply
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant plastering, wall lining and ceiling lining experience.

Skilled Meat Worker
Tibaldi (Aust) Pty Ltd
Clayton, Melbourne VIC
Full time
Salary range: $80,000 - $85,000 

Position Title:		Skilled Meat Worker
Team:				Fresh Meats
Location:			Clayton, Victoria
Reports to:			Boning Room Supervisor
Salary:				$80,000 - $85,000 Per Annum (Excl Superannuation)

Skilled Meat Worker
Join the Tibaldi team as a full-time Skilled Meat Worker based in Clayton, Victoria.

Our Story
Founded in 1934, the Tibaldi family of butchers had a dream to provide Australian’s with only the finest cuts of meats processed the traditional way using authentic Italian recipes.

90 years later not much has changed. Today, Tibaldi are a major supplier to the retail, route and food service industry across Australia. The company’s state of the art facilities in Clayton excel industry standards using leading technology. 

The product range spans across traditional Italian salami, ham, bacon, traditional smallgoods, fresh meat including a range of Outdoor Bred pork.

That’s Tradition. That’s Tibaldi.

Responsibilities and Duties
As a Skilled Meat Worker at Tibaldi you will be part of the Fresh Meats team based in Clayton, Victoria and will be involved in:

•	Using equipment to move carcasses and meat to boning and cutting tables
•	Trim, wash, and clean meat, removing blood, fat, and unwanted material
•	Cut carcasses into standard meat cuts like rumps, shoulders, and flanks
•	Remove internal fat, blood clots, bruises, and other waste materials
•	Operate restrainers and stunning equipment safely
•	Remove heads and head meat where required
•	Perform evisceration and trimming of carcasses

As part of our Fresh Meats team, you will have:

•	AQF Certificate III in Meat Processing
•	Skilled in the humane and efficient slaughter of livestock.
•	Follows strict safety procedures and demonstrates clear, effective communication skills.
•	Previous experience for a minimum of 2 years in a meat processing environment
•	The knowledge of food safety and hygiene standards
•	An understanding of humane animal handling
•	The ability to follow detailed procedures and demonstrates clear, effective communication skills.

Our Ways of Working
Our hourly rates of pay are dependent upon your levels of experience.

As part of our Tibaldi team you will be able to:
•	Participate in our Tibaldi Team Product Orders program that enables you to purchase our products at a below-retail price
•	Access free on-site car parking
•	Access our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
•	Participate in training and development courses tailored to your needs; both on-site and off-site
•	Travel to work on public transport as we are conveniently located close to public transport including Westall or Clayton train stations

Pre-Employment Medical
A pre-employment medical will form part of the recruitment process.

External Recruitment
Candidates interested in this position should apply directly to this advertisement as we
are not accepting applications from recruitment agencies at this time.

www.tibaldi.com.au #tibaldi
